confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by district and hotel category; the 1-star and 3-star hotel anchors are least certain. Accommodation assumes ordinary July rates, not off-season, with taxes as best estimated. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against beer (cocktail about 3x, wine glass about 1.5x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value came from search-result summaries and was not verified on the RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Central and Southeastern European capitals with similar tourism demand, such as Sofia and Budapest, and against Romania's domestic price level. No live listings or price pages were checked.
